payload.headline: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 14, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 3 per equity share.
Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 21-Oct-2026.
Standalone and Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026.
